messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: P0 for service=db-proxy - high error rate and connection queueing. Rule: db-proxy->pgconn_exhaustion. PagerDuty: page fired -> alex (primary on-call).
pagerduty: Incident created: INC-2024-4821. Escalation policy: 5m -> secondary.
alex (oncall): acked. Looking. Can someone grab DB metrics and recent deploys?
mira (dba): on it — checking pg bouncer and Postgres stats. Noted spikes in waiting_clients and 5xx from app.
jamal (sre): I see Redis latency spike earlier which could be causing app threads to block and hold pg connections. Any recent cache churn?
sophia (app): We shipped a background job change 02:13 UTC that batches user-syncs. It ramps at 02:30. Could be correlating. Rolling that back now.
incident-bot: Audit: deploy/commit 9f3b2a7 to service-user-sync at 02:11 UTC.
alex (oncall): good call. mira, can you check active queries and long transactions? jamal, can we scale pgbouncer temporarily?
mira (dba): Running:
```sql
SELECT pid, state, query_start, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' ORDER BY query_start DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Found several long-running app transactions holding locks, longest ~11m. Several are stuck on Redis timeouts in app call stacks.
jamal (sre): Scaling pgbouncer pool +20% now. Also bumping max_client_conn and opening extra proxy pods. Pushing a quick config: `pgbouncer -c /etc/pgbouncer/pgbouncer.ini --reload`
alex (oncall): Sophia, confirm job rollback or throttle?
sophia (app): Rollback deployed (reverted commit 9f3b2a7). Background workers are being drained. Adding rate limit on /user-sync endpoint in front of workers.
customer-success: seeing elevated 502s for customers in EU region, started ~02:35. Customers impacted: a handful of PLG signups failing. Keeping support pinged.
alex (oncall): Triage: impact = degraded for a subset of requests (5xx, slower tail latencies). Mitigation steps: 1) rollback job (done), 2) scale pgbouncer + proxies (in progress), 3) kill stuck queries >5m if safe, 4) add temporary circuit-breaker in app for Redis failures.
mira (dba): Killing queries >6m on app_user_db (will do one by one):
```sql
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND now() - query_start > interval '6 minutes' AND usename='app_user';
```
Terminated 8 backends. Monitoring effect.
jamal (sre): After scaling, connection queue length dropped ~75% within 40s. p99 latency for DB requests back toward baseline. Redis latency still elevated but trending down after we throttle job.
mira (dba): Postgres locks cleared, replication lag normal. Continuing to watch for new leaks.
sophia (app): Added simple in-process Redis timeout fallback (200ms) and small circuit-breaker to stop holding pg conns while waiting. Deployed feature flag off -> toggled on for 5% of traffic to smoke test.
alex (oncall): Good. @customer-success please advise affected customers and set expectation: transient failures — engineering mitigations in progress.
customer-success: Notifying affected: message queued to EU accounts with temporary workaround.
jamal (sre): PagerDuty: escalations suppressed (we have ack + active mitigation). Marking notes in incident.
incident-bot: Note added: mitigation actions executed: rollback job, scale pgbouncer, kill stuck queries, circuit-breaker deploy.
mira (dba): DB connections stable ~90% of baseline, no new >6m queries.
sophia (app): Error rate down from 8% -> 0.6% over last 6m; tail latency p99 improved from 4s -> 420ms.
alex (oncall): Plan: Continue observation for 30m. Follow-ups: postmortem to include root cause analysis (likely job-backed Redis timeouts causing app to hold DB conns), add alert for long-running app transactions, increase pgbouncer autoscale thresholds, and add circuit-breaker patterns to other potentially blocking calls. Assign owners: postmortem -> jamal, fix rollout -> sophia, DB tuning -> mira.
jamal (sre): I'll open incident ticket and include timeline + metrics.
incident-bot: Incident status: monitored -> stable. If no regressions in 30m, we'll close the pager.
alex (oncall): handing to jamal for follow-up post-window. Leaving note: oncall->jamal handoff. :white_check_mark:
jamal (sre): ack. I'll drive the follow-ups and schedule a short war-room for 11:00 UTC to dig deeper.
customer-success: Thanks team — keeping customers updated.
alex (oncall): thanks all — great coordination.
